note: A pattern is a CMS section (header + layout + items) and is what fills a space of a template contract. Full specs: the component card and DESIGN.md › M9P. `proposed` and `proposedTemplates` list what Figma proposes and the DL Manager has not approved: point to them, never treat them as approved.
composition: One heavy pattern each per page (leaderboard, bento-grid); never two rows of the same item type back to back
No empty sections: a section with nothing is removed; a section whose data fails to load shows SectionError in its place, and the page keeps working

patterns.what: The top of a destination landing: photo, search bar, title and four quick actions.
patterns.placement: L1 hero; actions are the P2 stage hub
patterns.mindset: Actions follow the phase; a booking action is withheld for D and O

patterns.what: The person's next bookings at the top of a landing page.
patterns.mindset: State for everyone; controls (cancel, change) only for I and C

patterns.what: A section with a row of tiles that scrolls sideways: categories, products or faces.
patterns.mindset: Products never in pre-desire or sacred windows

patterns.what: A section of topic chips that wrap.
A row of media cards that scrolls sideways; layout grid gives the 2 × 2 grid.
patterns.placement: P1 at the step that needs it (3), P2 (5), slot (6)
patterns.mindset: Booking cards withheld for D and O

patterns.what: A row of vertical playlist cards.
patterns.placement: P1; collapses to the faith strip during a journey

patterns.what: Pages of two horizontal playlist cards that scroll sideways.
One featured media card, full width. A layout, never a ranking.
patterns.mindset: One featured card; never a ranking

patterns.what: A preparation guide: hint widgets that scroll sideways with page dots.
patterns.placement: P1 at the step it prepares for
patterns.mindset: Ticks private; shown to D as preparation, not tasks

patterns.what: A tinted box with a 4-column grid of service tiles: a stage hub.
A mixed grid of four media cards and an optional "Show more".
patterns.mindset: Content only; never offers in pre-desire

patterns.what: Stacked full-width media cards with an optional "Show more".
patterns.placement: P1 at a booking step (3), slot (6)
patterns.mindset: Booking cards withheld for D and O
